description: This file defines API endpoints related to managing chess games, including creating, listing, retrieving, submitting moves, saving/loading snapshots, and deleting games. It uses FastAPI for HTTP routing, SQLAlchemy for database operations, and interacts with chess logic and models to handle game state and move history.

methods.description: Serializes a Move object into a MoveResponse schema.

methods.description: Converts a Game object into a GameResponse schema, deriving turn and check status.

methods.description: Checks if a user ID exists in the database when provided.

methods.name: GameResponse create_game(payload: CreateGameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new chess game, optionally associated with users.

methods.name: List[GameResponse] list_games( userId: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter games by participant userId."), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list chess games, optionally filtered by user participation.

methods.name: GameResponse get_game(game_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches a specific game by ID, including move history.

methods.name: GameResponse submit_move(game_id: str, payload: SubmitMoveRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Validates and applies a move to an active game, updating game state.

methods.name: SnapshotResponse save_game_snapshot(game_id: str, payload: SaveGameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Saves the current game state as a named snapshot, upserting if name exists.

methods.name: GameResponse load_game_snapshot(game_id: str, payload: LoadGameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Restores game state from a named snapshot, discarding moves after snapshot.

methods.name: Response delete_game(game_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a game and its associated records.
